items.question: What did Kara Braxton win in the WNBA?
items.answer: USA Today reported that Kara Braxton was a WNBA All-Star. The WNBA said she was a two-time champion and a 10-season veteran who played for the Detroit Shock, Tulsa Shock, Phoenix Mercury and New York Liberty. She was drafted No. 7 overall in 2005 by the Detroit Shock, made the All-Rookie Team, and won championships in 2006 and 2008 with Detroit.
